reviews.title: Cheaters!!! Beware!
reviews.text: This company is a bunch of cheaters. Two of us were booked on a flight with them for September 2020. The flight was cancelled a few days after it was booked. We still managed to go on a trip via other airlines. When in Greece I called them and inquired about a refund. They said they would issue a voucher valid for 18 months and if not used they would issue a refund. The voucher was never issued. 18 months later I email them on the refund. Their response was to call them??? No airline is asking that. Email is usually enough or they do it automatically. When I tried to call it was obvious the numbers they provide were not in operation. In fact tried again a week ago when on vacation in Greece again. No wonder there is info on the web stating they closed down. They act as if the did. I wonder how a company like this can still legally exist.
reviews.author: Victoria D

reviews.title: The worst airline ever - they didnt refund the cost of cancelled flight
reviews.text: They cancelled my flight and didnt want to refund, they offered a voucher valid for 18months and told me that if I don't use it then they will refund my flight, after 18 monts they don't even bother to reply my emails. Avoid this airline! Worst experience ever!
reviews.author: Monika L

reviews.title: They sell, cancel and don't reimburse
reviews.text: I booked two flights with ellinair airlines 7 months ago. Both flights were cancelled. And we still are waiting for the reimbursement. The flights are (booking number B3RBF5 Heraklion-Miscow And FZIANM Moscow - Korfu for two passengers Stepaniuk Stefaniia and Stepaniuk Mikhaïl They do not reply my emails - I ve just read through trust pilot that I m to the old one with that problem. If the reimbursement is not resolved with 1 month it will be official - they steal money from the customers.
reviews.author: Надя Т

reviews.title: SCAM company
reviews.text: SAVE YOUR MONEY AND BOOK LITERALLY ANY OTHER AIRLINE. They cancelled my flight in June 2021 and have yet to refund my money. After more than a dozens calls, emails, etc, there has been no response, nothing. They are a FRAUD company. Avoid like the plague.
reviews.author: Vadim M

reviews.title: Criminals and fraud
reviews.text: The don't reply and since June they haven't refunded my flights. Please boycott this company. This is unacceptable
reviews.author: Lorenzo R

reviews.title: No ticket refund for three months
reviews.text: I don't usually leave negative reviews, but I've been literally waiting for a refund for three months now. First, they canceled the flight a week before flying, without any further instructions on rebooking or anything. I called and rebooked the flight but it got canceled again. I don't mind the cancellation, it's the service that's terrible. I called them and they asked me to send an email to which I got a reply after more than two months. Still waiting for my money, and when I try to call them they don't pick up. It's shameful that an official company like this has basically stolen our money because until it's returned I consider this theft.
reviews.author: MTTraveling

reviews.title: Awful service
reviews.text: They have canceled me flight due to COVID. 8 months later stil haven’t get my refund! Worst experience ever.
reviews.author: Evropi Stefanidou

reviews.title: Cancellation of flights by Ellinair
reviews.text: I booked flights with Ellinair from Heraklion, Crete to Bucharest in June 2021. Ellinair cancelled my flights days after I made the booking. I received an email telling me that the flight had been cancelled but nothing in the email to advise how or when I would be refunded the fare paid. I called their customer service dept and was told to email requesting a refund. I received a reply to the email 2 months later advising that due to covid 19 there would be a delay in making the refund. I have still not received any refund. I would not trust this airline and I shall never use them again.
reviews.author: Caroline H

reviews.title: No ticket refund for cancelled flights
reviews.text: I'm trying to get my money from Ellinair since June 2021. The airline was selling tickets for flights it was not sure it would make. Tten it cancelled flights giving COVID-19 as the reason. After that contrary to the EU legislation t did not refund the money that was paid for the tickets for cancelled flights. I think all this has traces of fraudulent behaviour. Stating on your official site that you are not flying is not the reason for continuing selling tickets that are not worth the paper they are printed on. If there are EU citizens who suffered from this airline I think they ought to make Ellinair answer for its misconduct.
reviews.author: Yura1956

reviews.title: Cancelled flights and not refunding money!
reviews.text: They have cancelled flights twice so I've asked them for a refund. It's been more than 40 days since my request and they still haven't refunded and also they are not replying to my emails. I've had just 1 reply from an Ellinair representative during this period. Avoid at all costs!
reviews.author: Catalin M

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: My flight was canceled. Are you planning to give me back my money??? I’m calling the Greek mobile number, waiting 20mins in line, spending a lot of money on international calls. And a girl said to send an email. Sent an email, received an automatic reply that they would review my request during 6 weeks! Well I don’t have 6 weeks, I need my money back because I still need to go there and find another flight.
reviews.author: Ivan

reviews.title: Outbound flight cancelled but return flight was not
reviews.text: Got an email that outbound flight was cancelled and an amended booking to show that the return flight wasnt cancelled. NO automatic refund or anything. How are we supposed to use the return flight when the outbound flight has been cancelled? I called customer services and after 22minutes spent on hold the call was cut off. Having written an email to them, I got an automatic reply to say it takes up to six weeks to get a response. and then there is a question of getting a refund for accommodation booked...
reviews.author: Westbnd

reviews.title: Excellent service!
reviews.text: I booked economy class and thought I was allowed only 1 item 8kg. But the check in agent informed me that I could have my personal bag on board and put my little luggage in the aircraft at no extra cost. Much nicer than Aegean which charged us even for one cake from Duty Free as extra luggage. Well done Ellinair! Thank you very much!
reviews.author: Keli L

reviews.title: Very bad customer service
reviews.text: Very bad service in the airport of Herakleion. I had a problem concerning luggage and Ellinair was 100% absent and no one was there to help with my problem. I had to face irony and forced to pay half my ticket again, because local handler on behalf of Ellinair would not let me fly otherwise. I felt abandoned as a customer and as a person in a foreign place, and will never trust Ellinair for my travels
reviews.author: Traveler

reviews.title: Easy like flying!
reviews.text: Everything was fine ! No delays , no problem! A little bit strict with the hand luggage 🧳 but everyone is nowadays, so better be within limits! The gate in Athens was a little bit far, but that goes with the low cost as well! The site and checking in online is excellent! It would be great to have a mobile app though aswell! The browser on the mobile doesn’t really cut it , I had to use the laptop 💻! So to sum it up, ellinair you are gonna see me again! P.S. there are plenty seats 💺 you can choose with no extra cost!
reviews.author: panayiotisb

reviews.title: Everything according to schedule
reviews.text: This is the airline which belongs to the Mouzenidis Group with Greek and Russian shareholders and is based in Thessaloniki-Greece; the airline is carrying mainly tourists who book at Mouzenidis but is also doing inland flights in Greece;most of the flights are from and to countries of Eastern Europe ,especially Russia and Ukraine,but there also are some flights to Western Europe too ; at the moment ,the airline has seven aircraft ,Airbus and Boeing and the aircraft I flew with ,an Airbus A 320 with 180 seats ,seemed to me in a good condition,clean and with nothing to complain about ; this summer I was flying for the fourth time with Ellinair from Bucharest to Heraklion and I must say they improved a lot since 2016; in 2016 there was a delay of 8 hours ;this time ,like last year ,both flights were exactly on time with no delay at all; check-in was ok with 20 kg of checked in luggage ; on board we had served a sandwich and a drink ,soft or wine and also coffee or tea and a biscuit ; it was a really pleasant flight with friendly and nice Greek well chosen flight attendants ; next year ,when I will travel on my own to Heraklion ,I will probably chose Ellinair as they have the best fare from Bucharest to Heraklion,about 200 Euro return ,among the cheapest ,cheaper as Aegean for example ,who don’t have direct flights ,only with a stopover in Athens ;
reviews.author: Ulysses336

reviews.title: Horrible check in
reviews.text: This morning flying from Athens to Thessaloniki I had my cabin baggage to be moved to the checked in even though I was insisting that I needed it with me. The sizing was more than correct and other passengers had bigger suitcases than mine and they went through. While she was running de she threatened me that she would not let me be on the flight. As Greek it is horrible to find that Greek airlines are some of the worst due to their service and people! I wish I will never have to fly with them again!
reviews.author: ioanna p

reviews.title: Polite, punctual and clean
reviews.text: One of the two main air carriers in Greece, I have travelled quite few times with Ellinair and I am very pleased with their level of service,
reviews.author: Isidoros

reviews.title: Good but reservations Customer Service must step it up a notch !
reviews.text: Flight crew and check in crew were great but when we made the initial reservation on line and called in to inquire about pricing and a few other things, the staff was not that knowledgeable and had no control over anything. Supposedly all bookings are made by yourself on line (unless you want to pay extra for them to do it for you) but it’s the same info as you would have received from booking directly on line. Therefore I found the reservation staff completely useless.. not to mention almost impossible to get a hold of. I must have called over a dozen times so very unreliable.
reviews.author: NatureGirl

reviews.title: Great Flight experience
reviews.text: Nice flight from Thessaloniki to Athens. On time departure and arrival with friendly staff and good in-flight service for the given short flight time.
reviews.author: Explorer792064

reviews.title: Athens to Crete in luxury.
reviews.text: We had a very pleasant experience in booking, checking-in online and the actual flight experience. The service was more like the old days in that we didn't have to pay extra for the seats we selected and in-flight refreshments were issued by the cabin crew free of charge. There wasn't any in-flight menu which was probably due to the shortness of the flight. The cabin crew were very efficient and friendly and we were kept well informed by the captain and co-pilot of the flight progress and the weather conditions in Crete.
reviews.author: Topcat20

reviews.title: Thank you Ellinair
reviews.text: This greek airline took 144 British passengers from the Island to Manchester. Thank you for stepping in to repatriate us.
reviews.author: macur1966

reviews.title: No hassles, on time
reviews.text: Our flight on Aegean airlines was cancelled and we were transferred to the Ellinair flight, so we didn't choose it. However, the flight went without a hitch and was not delayed. During the 50 minute flight we were given a biscuit (hard!) and a bottle of water (useful). The aircraft was clean and new, so no complaints.
reviews.author: patinhongkong

reviews.title: Cancelled our tickets last minute and haven’t refunded. Terrible airline
reviews.text: This is the poorest experience I have ever had with an airline. Do not fly with Ellinair. My husband and I were on our honeymoon travelling to Greece from South Africa. We booked return flights from Athens to Mykonos months in advance to ensure we got a good rate. Ellinair sent us an email five days before we were due to fly stating that they had cancelled our return flight from Mykonos to Athens due to operational reasons. They were very vague with their reasonings and told us that we had to sort out our own refunds. I jumped in to action the same day they sent an email informing us of our flight cancelation, we emailed the booking agency “Gotogate” via sky scanner and they said our refund would be processed within 1-3 days. As a result of this last minute cancellation, we had to book a new return flight for almost double the cost of what I payed for my husband and I return. It has now been over three weeks, I have sent countless emails to Ellinair and Gotogate, neither have bothered to followed up the case. They just keep saying please wait an additional 1-3 days: This has been an exhausting and extremely frustrating experience. I have been out of pocket at the airlines expense. It is shocking that an airline can get away with this and withhold money from passengers when they are at fault. This has been a tiring process and I’m convinced that I won’t see the money returned to me. Would not recommend booking with this airline. Terrible, terrible service.
reviews.author: Michelle H

reviews.title: Cancelling flights a few days before departure with no communication to passengers?
reviews.text: Was about to travel today from Athens to rhodes. After trying to check in yesterday , i found out that the flight was not even scheduled anymore!! no info what so ever, no reason for cancellation. If you cant handle an issue like this i dont even want to think how you handle more important issues regarding flying... My first and obviously last booking with you!
reviews.author: savvasrodos

reviews.title: Very professional, excellent service!
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by the services of Ellinair. The aircraft was new, the airhostesses were well dressed, polite and friendly, we were offered snacks and beverages for free and the landing was impeccable! Totally recommend!
reviews.author: dim s

reviews.title: Smooth flight - I do recommend EllinAir
reviews.text: On-time-service flying on a quite modern A319 aircraft. Free beverages and snacks - excellent on-board-product. They don’t offer low-cost, but fair prices. Only risk could be that they have a fleet of only 10 aircrafts and a high number of small airlines got into insolvency in the last years. I hope that EllinAir is going to grow and could maybe even join SkyTeam or another alliance.
reviews.author: Jakob F

reviews.title: Great stuff
reviews.text: Very professional staff. Departure was on time. Arriving even earlier as scheduled )) everything was alright.
reviews.author: Alena Udalova

reviews.title: One of the best airline that is presented in Ukraine
reviews.text: I couldn't even imagine that they sell nothing at plane. Maybe, that's the best of flight: you can enjoy your window view and nobody will bother you. Flight food menu is quite well and staff is tidy and pleasant.
reviews.author: Alexander S

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: Was traveling from Mykonos to Athens Welcoming crew members Much needed complimentary water & cookies too.
reviews.author: Gokul D

reviews.title: Great company
reviews.text: Very professional aircompany, had no issues with them. Flight was smooth without any issues, complimentary sandwich snack with drinks and biscuits. Staff friendly, definitely will fly again
reviews.author: Emir K

reviews.title: Excellent airline
reviews.text: We flew 2 flights with them from Bucharest to Heraklion and Chania to Athens. Its a great airline, most likely one of the best in Europe. Food, candy and drinks on every flight. On the Bucharest flight an additional sandwich. Roughly on time. Excellent value for money would choose over aegean air!
reviews.author: DJordy

reviews.title: Ellinair cancelled my flight last minute so I had to scramble to purchase a new flight at more than twice the price.
reviews.text: I booked a flight with Ellinair over 4 months in advance but they canceled my flight on short notice. While Ellinair did give me a refund this put in a bad position to scramble for a new flight and pay over twice the price on short notice. My experience with Ellinair is terrible as they were unreliable in delivering the service I paid for in advance. I would highly recommend choosing a more reliable airline to avoid a last minute cancellation.
reviews.author: Matthew C

reviews.title: Transport by air
reviews.text: Very wellcoming cabin crew. Good leg space. Free snack (sandwich, biscuits, water, wine, beer) Cannot buy cosmetics, parfumes, etc.
reviews.author: Sergiu S

reviews.title: Dont ever book through this airline!!!!
reviews.text: Change of flight times and cancellation of booked flights due to ''commercial reasons'' as the airline claimed. The options given were either refund or fly through another city and only on two certain dates completely irrelevant to the dates booked. No manners and no respect on the phone. If anyone tries to read the term and conditions of the fares on offer will freak out. Check at the price and flight schedule sections before booking.
reviews.author: Cowlman

reviews.title: Cheap flights, good overall experience.
reviews.text: Experience was OK, cheap tickets. we flew from Mykonos to Athens. Online reservation was fast and straight forward, seat selection was easy and fast as well, flight itself was good and steady, their craft was clean and modern. can't complain at all. i will fly with them again.
reviews.author: fammari

reviews.title: Cancelled Flight
reviews.text: Purchased flight because out of all airlines it had a time that worked well for our itinerary. A few weeks later the flight was moved to another time, it was not as convenient but could make it work. Finally a few weeks later received an email that the flight was cancelled. Email was very vague and doesn't mention anything about when a refund will be processed. Contacted customer service several times with absolutely no response. Will not book with this airline again.
reviews.author: 926inam

reviews.title: Impotent Company
reviews.text: Horrible company, cancelling our flights twice through email without any further information. We had to call them up, change the flights, cancel previous hotel, book new hotel, pay cancellation fees, ending up 3 weeks later with a new email informing us for flight cancellation again!! Do not trust this company, even if you purchase your tickets it is not sure that you will fly to your destination.
reviews.author: Emy

reviews.title: Avoid this terrible airline
reviews.text: Our flight was cancelled twice!! We were offered different flights on new days, where they thought they might make enough money for it to be worth it to them. We had to book a new hotel. Then they cancelled this flight as well and yet again we're already set up with a hotel, this time without a full refund. No compensation given. do not trust this airline... We are now booking with a new airline or cancelling this as our honeymoon destination.
reviews.author: Guy E

reviews.title: Not Very Reliable, but Attractive in Terms of Price
reviews.text: Fight from Moscow to Thessaloniki and back. Ellinair is a small leisure airline, which operates only four middle range aircrafts, which poses certain risks. If one plane is out of order their whole schedule collapses significantly. That’s exactly what I had to experience, my return flight has been delayed for 10 hours. On the bright side Ellinair did all their best to inform me about the delay well in advance, so in the end I arrived to the airport at the appropriate time. Although everything worked out well, it was a bit stressful, as I had to depart on a business trip the next day. Had the delay been more significant I’d have run into trouble. The planes are new, seats are comfortable, had a good sleep on both flights. Cabin crews were polite and professional. Ground service was a bit chaotic though. To sum up, a very average airline for vacation travel. They have really attractive rates though.
reviews.author: Alex W

reviews.title: Nice charter airlines
reviews.text: We was flying this airlines at the first time. There - Boing 777 - clean and serviceable bort. Back - Airbus - was broken sit's arm and basket for magazines. But - both time we have a nice impressions. There was a fresh and tasty food, although there was a cold. Are assumed the drinks: tea, coffee,juice and red/white wine before you have a snack. Also the entertainment for children: book and colors pencils. Also children menu. Attentive staff, which says English & Elinika. It be pleasure will fly this company again
reviews.author: Vik

reviews.title: Very bad
reviews.text: Horrible interior in very old planes, long delays, terrible communication, no online check in. For connecting flights through Thessaloniki, passengers need to exit the area and repeat both check in and control.
reviews.author: Αλέξανδρος

reviews.title: Bad attitude
reviews.text: The aircraft was clean and tidy if a little tired. It had seen a lot of service. Crew were pleasant but we had a terrible experience at check in where the staff were very officious and unpleasant. Staff member said we must check in a piece of hand luggage as it weighed 2 kilos over the 8 limit. We pointed out that the scale showed 1.5 kilos before the bag was put on. The bag was the only one my wife and I had. She could not be moved. We were told that it was company rules; if we didn’t like it we should fly with another company. ......We will next time.
reviews.author: VamosBoy

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: My family and I traveled Ellinair last month and had a very positive experience. I wish they traveled to the US. I was a little hesitant given its a small, lesser-known airline, but after reading some reviews and seeing their low prices, I decided to give it a chance. The check in process was easy, the flight was smooth and quick, and we had no problems. I was very pleased with the flight, especially for the low price we paid. Included in that low price was a checked bag, something you don't get in many airlines today. That was a great perk and ultimately why I went with the airline, seeing as the other airlines had more expensive flights to begin with + extra charges for checked bags. Overall I have no complaints about this airline and truly had a great experience. Would recommend and fly anytime I'm ever in the region again!
reviews.author: tsalv0

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: Cancelled our flight 2 weeks before...still awaiting refund. Booked via skyscanner via go to gate. Will think next time and use Agean who were exceptional. If we hadn't picked a missed call up I think we would have been stranded at Athens airport!
reviews.author: julieju32

reviews.title: A very pleasant experience
reviews.text: We used Ellinair for our charter trip to Heraclion. The both flights were very pleasant, and on time. They serve candy at the boarding, which is appreciated by kids, and have special activity book with crayons for children. Also, kids menu and juices are available on board. For adults they serve regular "plane food", water/tea/coffee/wine.
reviews.author: OksanaKyiv

reviews.title: excelent flight in an old aircraft
reviews.text: Excellent flight in an aircraft that first took of in 1998. Very smooth ride and very friendly staff. In addition , the ticket costed 30 euros less than the closest competition (Aegean)
reviews.author: Giorgos D

reviews.title: Smooth flight
reviews.text: The flight was very smooth, it was a pleasure to observe the fields and mountains beneath. The food service was also quite adequate, I was served the special meal I ordered at booking without an extra request. No in-flight entertainment, but it was just a 3-hour flight. The only bad experience was from the passport service at the arrival, as there were only two agents for the plane, and it took over an hour to finally emerge from the airport. But it can hardly be Ellinair's fault. Though it is to be expected evidently with late arrivals after 6 pm.
reviews.author: larmih

reviews.title: Great flight in windy conditions.
reviews.text: Even though the flight to Thessaloniki was very windy the flight and landing was very good. This is a national Greek airlines. Highly recommend this airline.
reviews.author: Elinda E

reviews.title: Flew them twice
reviews.text: We took Ellinair on 2 one way trips. The first was a quick flight to Thessaloniki Greece from Athens. The next was a longer flight to Stuttgart. On the longer flight, we got a turkey pasta lunch. Service was very good on both flights and on-time. The baggage policy is better than most European airlines. I’d definitely fly them again.
reviews.author: Steveh3Texas
